opportunities.name: Company account brief from SEC 10-K, Wikipedia and email
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, find the latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, look up the company on Wikipedia, and draft an email brief with the key facts.
steps: Enter the ticker and select the suggestion
Open the Form filter and choose the 10-K annual report
Search the company on Wikipedia for HQ, employees and CEO
Compose an email to the recipient with the subject and a body summarising the facts

instances.values: SNOW; SEC 10-K lookup plus Wikipedia, no email seen

opportunities.name: Time zone and holiday sync email
opportunities.description: For two cities, use the timeanddate Time Zone Converter to find the time difference, check the country's holidays for the month, and email ops a sync note with the offset and dates to avoid.
steps: Open Time Zones then Time Zone Converter
Search and add the first city
Search and add the second city
Open Calendar then Holidays and choose the country
Note the holiday dates for the month
Compose an email to ops with the subject and body giving the time difference and dates to avoid
